curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can the crew safely recover their missing colleague after they discover that the life-form they found may be dangerous?
curatedMovie.description: On the final day of humanity's first manned mission to Mars, an unauthorized dig for bacterial life triggers a catastrophic cave-in at Tantalus Base, exposing the departing crew to an unforeseen and lethal threat.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A tense, medium-paced sci-fi horror best experienced solo, balancing bleak isolation with steady, engaged suspense.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Ruairi Robinson blends grounded space exploration with visceral horror, turning the bleak Martian terrain into an isolating pressure cooker of suspense.
